title: PRESSER | Walker Hooks - Fall Ball Wrap-Up (11-16-26)
text: Just what are your thoughts on the the ABS system? >> Uh, I think it's going to be I think it's going to be cool. Um, especially watching in the big leagues, you get to see or if we really know the zone as well as we think we do. Uh, so I mean I think it'll be cool and it'll change the game for sure cuz I mean some of those small calls make I mean are huge in some games. So it should be fun. >> You didn't pitch in games this fall, right? >> Yes, sir. >> What What did you do? What was your >> uh so I so the beginning of the fall I kind of took a little time off uh of throwing or throwing bullpens um and so then I started kind of ramping up in the middle of it and I mean by the time I got ramped up fall balls pretty much over so I didn't have to throw in any inner squads and so I mean I was just in lifting throwing bullpens uh with Joel and now just getting ramp back up for the season now. I'm not going to make you evaluate any of the other pitchers, but what did you see from the overall general from your teammates from generally? >> Uh, I mean, we got a lot of talent uh offensive side. I mean, we got a bunch of guys back that uh made the offense go last year and then pitching wise, we had uh I mean, all the new guys have looked really good so far and so I'm excited to see what uh in the spring. >> What do you think your role kind of remained the same as it was last year? Are you shooting to be a starter or what's your what's your goal? >> You know, it's I mean, it really just depends how I we got so many guys this year. So, I mean, of course, I think my goal is to be a starter and I think that's everybody's goal. Um, but if it doesn't work out that way, I mean, we got so many great guys that I think it's it's going to be hard to earn a roll this year and so it'll be good. Are you are you trying to uh do anything with your pitching as far as gaining velocity or adding a new pitch or anything? >> Yeah. Uh so that's kind of what I've been doing this fall is trying to get in strength training, get a little bit more couple more miles an hour or a couple ticks up on the VO and then uh adding a couple new pitches. Joel's been working with me. So >> how's that go? How's that how's that working out? >> Uh I think it's been it's been good. Um, I've only thrown it against hitters like one time, so I haven't got like many at bats in it. So, I mean, it's been fine in bullpens. Uh, so I'm super excited to see how it works against hitters. >> You pitched like five innings in game one Lincoln region a while back. Do you think that that game kind of proved you can go out there and be a starter? >> Uh, I mean, it's I think anybody could do that. I mean, it's just still pitching. It's I think anybody can go five innings, four innings. I mean, it's just the competitiveness. Uh but uh yeah, I mean I think so. >> I don't know. >> Got more lefties this year than ever. So >> does that add to the competition aspect of it? >> Uh I I love it. I love that we have a lot of lefties cuz I think lefties lefties win and especially when you have good lefties. I mean they're hard to hit. >> Yeah. >> And I mean I don't really know why but uh >> Yeah. I mean it should I mean it should be good. I mean we got some great arms and we should be deep. I'm good. Good, brother.
